messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT — High p95 latency on service inference-runtime-east1 detected (since 2167894200). Auto-pager triggered to SRE on-call. Metrics: p95 ~ 1200ms, error rate spike ~0.8%. Suggested impact: degraded response times for hosted API customers in us-east.

maria: I'm on it — joining war room. Can someone post the war room link? I'll take owner for initial triage unless someone else needs it.

ajay: pagerduty confirmed delivery. war room created: https://warroom.redwood.company/r/ir-east1-2167894321

maria: joining. quick checklist:
- confirm customer impact
- identify if rollout/compaction/infra is involved
- gather top traces and recent deploys
- escalate to infra if GPU cluster IO looks saturated

sam: adding logs snapshot to war room. short grep for high-latency traces:

```
# from log-shipper
grep -E "inference-runtime.*latency" /var/logs/ir/2026-03-15.log | tail -n 50
```

leo: I see a batch size increase in the autoscaler logs around 2167894100 that correlates with the spike. Posting kernel metrics now.

maria: @oncall-bot please confirm we've paged infra-ops and platform. Also confirm the current on-call is @ajay.

oncall-bot: @ajay is the scheduled on-call (rotation: infra-ops). Pager confirmed at 2167894325. infra-ops has been notified.

ajay: infra here — looking at GPU utilization. One node in pool gp-3 shows high GPU memory pressure and a lot of memcpy stalls. Suspect bump in batch/windowing.

maria: owner assigned: maria (SRE). ajay -> infra owner for node-level investigation. sam -> logs/traces. leo -> autoscaler heuristics.

tara-cs: heads-up — customer-impact assessment: likely medium. Some API requests are seeing >1s latency but not widespread errors yet. I'll prepare a status page fragment if we confirm impact.

maria: draft status-page update (internal review):

```
Summary: Customers in us-east may experience increased response times for text generation and chat endpoints between ~2167894100 and ongoing. Root cause under investigation (suspected autoscaler batching/config interaction).
Impact: Increased latency (p95 ~1.2s) for a subset of hosted customers in us-east. No widespread 5xx errors reported at this time.
Mitigation: Scaling adjustments and a targeted node drain are in progress. We will update within 30 minutes.
```

ajay: suggested customer-notification blurb for CS to use (short):

"We're investigating increased response times affecting AI inference in our us-east region. Our engineers are actively mitigating; we'll share updates shortly."

tara-cs: copying into the external template. Will hold publish until we confirm scope. If impact is medium+ we push to status.redwood.ai and email affected customers.

maria: immediate mitigations executed:
- disabled aggressive batching override on autoscaler (rolled back config change at 2167894380)
- initiated drain of gp-3-7 (node with memory pressure)
- temporarily pinned model variant to quantized-1 to reduce memory pressure

sam: logs show tail latency decreasing after drain start. p95 trending down to ~700ms. continuing to monitor.

leo: autoscaler metrics show batch sizes returning to baseline after rollback. posting chart screenshots in war room.

maria: next actions:
- if p95 < 600ms for 10m, we transition to monitoring and update status page to "mitigated"
- if not, escalate to emergency infra and consider temporary capacity bump in us-east

ajay: node drain completed at 2167894410. I kicked a small capacity bump (2 extra GPUs) as a precaution; will rollback if not needed.

oncall-bot: Action log:
- 2167894321: Alert triggered
- 2167894325: Pager delivered to @ajay
- 2167894380: autoscaler config rollback
- 2167894410: node gp-3-7 drained

tara-cs: status page ready. Draft content for external (short):

"We are investigating increased inference latency affecting customers in the US-East region. Engineers are actively mitigating the issue. We will provide updates within 30 minutes. — Redwood Inference"

maria: agreed. I'll sign off when p95 stabilizes. For audit: note that a recent internal autoscaler change (canary) was rolled back — will follow up with a post-incident action item to improve canary safeguards.

sam: monitoring alert policy adjusted to add a secondary threshold on memcpy stalls so we can detect earlier.

leo: tagging this thread with incident-severity: P2 for now. If customer reports mount we'll raise to P1.

maria: thanks all. keeping war room open. please post any customer confirmations here and ping me directly if you see regression. :white_check_mark:

ajay: 👍 monitoring shows p95 at ~520ms now. recommending transition to monitoring-only in 10m if stable.

tara-cs: publishing external status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2167894321 (draft -> public). I pasted the exact blurb.

maria: public update posted. closing owner handoff to on-call for follow-up and RCA. full RCA will include autoscaler canary gap and a recommended safety kill-switch.

oncall-bot: incident thread archived to war room. If new alerts surface, this thread will be re-opened.
